account_partner_meta_description: The partner's page: your link and QR, your customers and referral gifts.
account_partner_hero_lead: Anyone who comes with your link or QR, or whose details you write in “Customers”, is registered under your name.
account_partner_notice_sheba_title: To receive referral gifts, we need your Sheba number.
account_partner_notice_sheba_body: Zurvann pays your gifts into this Sheba.
account_partner_notice_inactive: Your partnership is paused for now; your link and entries don't register anyone under your name. To start again, call Zurvann.
account_partner_shop_caption: Scan and start with a free evaluation
account_partner_shop_hint: Put this card by your register.
account_partner_funnel_empty: Nobody yet; you can also enter customers you know, with their details.
account_partner_commission_rule: Each time a customer you introduced buys a course and pays, you get a referral gift; no purchase, no gift. The more buying customers you bring, the higher your percent goes. Zurvann pays the gift by bank transfer and texts you.
account_partner_commission_none: No gifts yet. Each time your customer buys a course, it shows up here.
account_partner_error_incomplete_body: Call Zurvann so they can complete your account.
account_partner_error_failed_body: Something went wrong. Open the page again or call Zurvann.
account_partner_commission_progress: You've brought {count} paying customers so far; your customer no. {next} earns {percent}.
account_partner_commission_progress_none: No paying customers yet; your first one earns {percent}.
account_partner_terms_lead: Before you see your link and QR and enter customers, read and accept the terms of partnering with Zurvann.
